purpose: Close the highest-value remaining VPS-representable local Voice evidence before any S4 physical-microphone/speaker acceptance. Reuse existing Voice authorities and accepted model/runtime subjects; this artifact is a falsifier/benchmark design and grants zero runtime/product credit by itself.

asr_preferred_existing_subject.reason: Already pinned and already used in current F2 owner-VPS Voice evidence; native cache-aware streaming makes it the highest-information way to close the remaining partial-streaming field without model churn.

tts_existing_subject.policy: Reuse the exact currently accepted local TTS subject first (Piper/Kokoro-Piper path where current Trigger4 evidence binds it). Do not introduce a replacement merely to make cancellation easier.
tts_existing_subject.fallback_research_only: If the accepted producer is structurally one-shot and cannot expose preemption, record PRODUCT_LIMITATION or EXECUTION_INTERFACE_LIMITATION before evaluating an already-pinned streaming TTS candidate; no silent architecture swap.

primary_source_refresh.finding: Nemotron-3.5-ASR-Streaming-0.6B supports controllable streaming latency in the 80 ms to 1 s range; MagpieTTS multilingual includes German.
Local native C++ ASR/TTS runtime exists, so an offline/network-disabled VPS discriminator is representable without external inference.

method: Use the already-pinned Nemotron 3.5 ASR Q8 local subject and feed fixed German audio incrementally at 80 ms, 160 ms and 320 ms chunk settings where the runtime exposes them.
Reuse the exact known German HOLD and interrupt fixtures from the accepted owner-VPS run first; add only already-admitted pinned German corpus samples if present.
Timestamp every audio-chunk admission, every partial hypothesis/revision, endpoint decision and final hypothesis using one monotonic clock domain.
Inject partial/final state into the existing Voice input/turn-policy boundary without granting partial hypotheses durable tool or answer authority.
Repeat long-silence reentry and self-correction-before-tool scenarios with the same causal turn IDs.
pass_invariants: At least one genuinely pre-final ASR hypothesis is observed from incrementally admitted audio; final-only transcription cannot mint true-streaming credit.
No superseded partial transcript gains durable answer/tool authority.
Long silence does not silently resurrect or overwrite stale turn identity.
Final transcript remains causally bound to the same input lineage and exact model/runtime subject.

method: Generate a deliberately long fixed German utterance through the exact accepted local TTS producer.
Trigger barge/cancel after the first producer-visible PCM segment or earliest measurable partial-production boundary.
Measure cancel-request, producer acknowledgement/termination, producer CPU stop, generated-chunk sequence, sink admissions and packet commit_eligible state separately.

If the current producer is an isolated one-shot process, process termination is admissible as a preemption mechanism only when exact process ownership and output packet identity are bound and cleanup is deterministic.
Do not count sink-only rejection as producer-cancellation evidence.
pass_invariants: No post-cancel producer output is admitted to the sink.
Producer execution becomes terminal/preempted through an observed mechanism rather than merely generating unseen audio indefinitely.
Exact model/process/output-packet identity is preserved in the receipt.

method: Prestage all exact model/runtime artifacts, then execute the composed ASR plus TTS discriminator inside a positively identified disposable sandbox with external network disabled at the sandbox namespace/container layer (for example Podman --network=none or an equivalent admitted fence).
Verify the network fence independently before inference using a bounded expected-failure probe; do not rely only on a language-level socket monkeypatch.
Run local ASR and local TTS successfully and bind exact binary/model hashes plus the network-fence evidence.
pass_invariants: External network is demonstrably unavailable during promotion-bearing inference.
Local ASR and TTS inference still execute successfully from prestaged artifacts.
No hidden remote model/API dependency is required.

method: Drive the existing Voice Packet Cortex through a bounded many-turn session approaching its configured input/output/event/tool caps; periodically include real local ASR/TTS samples so the test is not purely structural.
Record RSS/PSS, packet counts, tool counts, output counts, event counts and causal session/turn identifiers at fixed intervals.
At a configured capacity boundary require explicit fail-closed behavior or an already-authorized causally bound rollover; silent eviction is a failure.
This bounded stress is not a substitute for later 30-minute/multi-hour human conversation acceptance.
pass_invariants: No silent causal-identity eviction or duplicate durable packet authority under capacity pressure.
Resource use remains bounded or terminates fail-closed with exact classification.
Restart/checkpoint semantics are not redefined by this experiment and existing FDX7/FDX8 runtime ownership is not duplicated.

ordering_reason: FDX12 is cheap and can invalidate the whole fully-local premise quickly; true partial streaming then closes the largest current ASR evidence gap; producer preemption closes the explicit FDX3 limitation; bounded long-session stress follows after the realtime primitives are valid.
